gaps.title: Absence of spatial multilayer PCB heat spreading formulation
gaps.impact: Engine cannot model thermal gradients across PCB surfaces or hot spot dissipation through copper layers.
gaps.closurePlan: Implement MultilayerPcbThermalStackup and SpatialThermalSolver with harmonic/effective in-plane & through-plane conductivity.

gaps.title: Lack of discrete conservative finite-volume conductance network
gaps.impact: Thermal simulations cannot guarantee nodal energy conservation at discrete boundaries.
gaps.closurePlan: Discretize domain into cells with exact face flux balance: sum(G_ij * (T_i - T_j)) + h*A*(T_i - T_inf) = Q_i.

gaps.title: No component junction-to-case-to-board calculation hierarchy
gaps.impact: Semiconductor thermal limits (T_j <= 125C, 150C) are unverified against spatial board temperature fields.
gaps.closurePlan: Implement standard JEDEC 2-resistor / multi-resistor package thermal model (R_theta_JC, R_theta_CS).

gaps.title: Singular matrix and unconstrained domain vulnerabilities
gaps.impact: Pure Neumann boundary conditions (adiabatic with no convective or Dirichlet sink) result in infinite temperature / singular matrix.
gaps.closurePlan: Implement strict matrix condition checking, singularity detection, and failure-closed validation error reporting.

gaps.title: Absence of automated grid convergence & analytical slab benchmark suite
gaps.impact: Lack of independent mathematical proof verifying spatial solver against exact analytical Fourier solutions.
gaps.closurePlan: Construct 11 comprehensive tests in spatial_thermal_verification.test.ts verifying analytical 1D/2D solutions, grid refinement, energy balance, and failure modes.
